title: Giants 'working through' starting quarterback situation after benching Jameis Winston

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Giants 'working through' starting quarterback situation after benching Jameis Winston
sources.description: After benching Jameis Winston in Sunday's 34-27 loss to the New Orleans Saints Sunday afternoon and watching J.J. McCarthy nearly lead the team to a comeback win in his Giants debut, New York was left with an important question: Is it time to switch things up at quarterback once again, at least for Week 7?
